chat.text: I'm trying to decide between using Jackson and GSON for a high-throughput Java service that processes very large, deeply nested JSON arrays of telemetry data. I've read the general documentation, but I'm looking for a more empirical answer on performance for this specific use case. In your opinion, which one is actually faster for parsing deeply nested structures, and do you have any actual performance data or benchmark results that could help me make a decision?
